## Description

What do you want Open PiPi to do?

## Use Case

Why is this useful? Who benefits?

## Proposed Approach

If you have ideas on implementation, describe them here.
Remember: new capabilities should be **skills** (`src/skills/*.skill.ts`), not core changes.

## Hardware Requirements

Does this need external hardware or sidecar services? (devices, cameras, custom runners, etc.)
